properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The app's actual signing surface: elliptic's secp256k1 preset (defineCurve at 11917) plus ethers' SigningKey machinery (new EC('secp256k1') at 12413, curve property at 12419, curve check at 17150) in the ethers-5.6 bundle used by Day39/html-fund-me. Every wallet operation in the front end signs Ethereum transactions with ECDSA-secp256k1 through this code. Shor-vulnerable; Ethereum has no PQ signature scheme yet, so this is changeable only ecosystem-wide — the app has no local migration path beyo

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum V3 keystore cipher path in the vendored ethers bundle: decrypt accepts cipher aes-128-ctr (16714) and encrypt hardcodes cipher 'aes-128-ctr' (16984). CTR is fixed by the keystore spec; integrity is provided by a separate keccak-256 MAC over the ciphertext (checked at 16727), so it is malleable-only-if-MAC-skipped rather than an AEAD, and the MAC does cover the ciphertext.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR is the V3-keystore cipher in the vendored ethers bundle (decrypt accepts 'aes-128-ctr' at 16714; encrypt defaults to cipher 'aes-128-ctr' at 16984), key derived via scrypt/pbkdf2. AES-128 is quantum-resistant but keeps only a 64-bit Grover margin — below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 preference; the 128-bit key is fixed by the keystore spec, so this is observable/replaceable only via the spec.
